## UI polish: App header and payment dialog 14 fixes across Spacing, Typography, Contrast, Hierarchy and States, plus the swap to tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from the pasted tokens. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `.bar` has `padding: 14px 16px`, and 14px is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-16)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: `.hero` has `padding: 50px 24px`. Now `padding: var(--space-48) var(--space-24)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: `.hero h1` has `margin: 0 0 10px`. Now `margin: 0 0 var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Spacing**: `.dlg` has `padding: 20px`. Now `padding: var(--space-24)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Spacing**: `.go` has `padding: 10px 14px`. Now `padding: var(--space-12) var(--button-padding-x)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-32) 6. **Typography**: `.amount` has `font-size: 13px`, which is off the scale and under the 16px body minimum. Now `var(--font-size-md)`. The 500 weight is now `var(--font-weight-medium)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **Typography**: the h1 gets `line-height: var(--line-height-heading)`. `.amount`, `.dlg p` and the header text get `var(--line-height-body)`. None had a line-height set. (R-ui-polish-3) 8. **Typography**: `.amount` and `.dlg p` get `max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-3) 9. **Contrast**: no text colour was set anywhere. Now `color: var(--color-text-default)` on `.bar`, `.hero` and `.dlg`, at 14.25:1. (R-ui-polish-4, R-ui-polish-20) 10. **Hierarchy**: Cancel was an unstyled button next to the filled primary. It is now secondary: transparent, with `var(--button-secondary-text)` text and a `var(--button-secondary-border)` border. Confirm stays the only primary action. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21) 11. **States**: both buttons get `:hover`, `:focus-visible` (`outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus)`, offset 2px) and `:disabled` styles. (R-ui-polish-6) 12. **States**: both buttons get `min-height` and `min-width` of `var(--size-target-min)`, plus `font-size: var(--font-size-md)`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-2) 13. **States**: the header and dialog use glass with no solid fallback. A `background: var(--color-surface-raised)` line now comes before each glass line. The glass and blur are kept. (R-ui-polish-33) 14. **Tokens**: raw values now use their variables, each with the same value or on scale. (R-ui-polish-20, R-ui-polish-32, R-ui-polish-33) - `z-index: 20` becomes `var(--z-sticky)`. - `z-index: 9999` becomes `var(--z-modal)`. - `border-radius: 10px` becomes `var(--r-md)`. - `1px solid` becomes `var(--border-width-hairline)`. - `#fff` becomes `var(--button-primary-text)`. - `--color-action-primary-bg` becomes `var(--button-primary-bg)`. ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Header, hero and dialog text | no colour set (browser default) | `--color-text-default` (#202d2c) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 14.25:1 | | Confirm (primary) | #ffffff on #0f766e, 5.47:1 | `--button-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--button-primary-bg` (#0f766e), 5.47:1 | | Confirm hover (new) | none | `--button-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--button-primary-bg-hover` (#0c403c), 11.58:1 | | Cancel (new) | none | `--button-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-surface-raised` (#ffffff), 5.47:1 | | Cancel hover (new) | none | `--button-secondary-text` (#0f766e) on `--color-selected-bg` (#f0fdfc), 5.25:1 | Ratios computed by hand with the formula; run the contrast script to confirm them. The contrast script could not run here: the command was not approved. ### Polished code ```html
Acme Billing

Your balance

1,204.50 USD

Confirm this payment?

``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Brand hue kept: #0f766e (`--color-brand`). - Glass, `--glow`, `--btn-gloss`, weight 500, `tabular-nums` and the `clamp()` heading are kept. - Token file: not edited. ### Open questions - Drift: the buttons use `border-radius: 10px`, which equals `--r-md`, so I wrote `var(--r-md)`. `--button-radius` is 6px. Say if buttons should use `--button-radius` instead. - `.dlg` is `position: fixed` with no `top`, `left` or `transform`. I have no screenshot, so I did not check or change where it sits. Send one if it looks misplaced. - The pasted tokens have no dark values, so I did not check a dark theme.
